_comment: Feathers Phase-2 smoke-test egg. Prints a heartbeat via PowerShell. No install step, no server files required. Docker image is ignored by the winproc backend.
name: Feathers Heartbeat Test
author: test@feathers.local
description: Minimal Windows test egg for the winproc backend. Launches a PowerShell loop that prints a heartbeat line every 2 seconds. Used to verify power actions and console streaming end-to-end through the Panel without needing an install step or any server files.
